Luigi Morelli
What a nice GUI based mining tool for experiments!

At first I was a bit scared about this little jewel... 1MH/s is a lot of work for small ESP32 biprocessor.

Instead, the hashrate was quite constant. The configuration was easy, the use was a breeze, and the three screens on the display show a lot of information.

Very useful the choice to hold the maximum worked difficulty between restarts! Also, opening the browser on the Internet IP address of the miner shows a panel with all the miners present on your private network (on the photo there is only one miner, but I long to have more soon...).

All in all an interesting and mature product, that is pushing me to add more solo miners on my network.
